name: bilance
description: Ask about your own money: accounts and balances, transactions, budgets, recurring payments, and a once-a-day bank refresh.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Bilance account and ask about your own finances: accounts and balances, transactions (including CSV export), budgets, and recurring payments. Read-only, apart from a bank refresh you can trigger at most once a day. You sign in with your Bilance account and can disconnect at any time in the app under Settings > Connected AI apps.
defaultPrompt: What did I spend on groceries last month?
How am I doing against my budgets?
